_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Units and converting between them
framework: Professor Adow TVET — Shapes and Measurements

criteria.text: Convert between millimetres, centimetres and metres without changing the quantity.
Work in ONE unit throughout a calculation and state which unit an answer is in.
Convert between square metres and square millimetres, and between cubic metres and litres, correctly.
Recognise an answer whose unit is impossible for the quantity asked, and say why.
